data.name: War Fantasy
data.detailed_description:
————— A NEW VISION OF HORROR —————

An unflinching examination of gaming's ever-present relationship with violence and the machinery of warfare. This game will not pull punches or ignore the tragic cost of conflict. Player actions have consequences. 

This is not a power fantasy. There is no heroism here. The boundary between simulation and reality is collapsing. There is only the next instruction.

————— WHAT THIS IS —————

War Fantasy is a psychological horror first-person shooter about the merging of war video games and real war.

You are dropped into an infinite military training compound. Your commanding officer watches. He instructs. He corrects. He grooms. Every shot you fire, every order you follow, every moment you hesitate is logged and fed back into a system designed with one purpose: to turn you into an attack dog.

Navigate surreal, impossible spaces built from the architecture of the military industrial complex: corridors that loop, training simulations with no exits, war factories that sprawl endlessly. Wield the latest in modern firearms that feel real because the game needs you to believe they are. And listen closely to the voice that never stops watching, never stops conditioning, and always wants to see you suffer.

The twisted offspring of Spec Ops: The Line and The Stanley Parable. An infinitely looping Black Mirror episode with no escape. War Fantasy draws a straight line from Stanley Kubrick's Full Metal Jacket to the first-person shooter genre and asks: what have games been training us for, and what does the future of war games look like?

————— WHAT YOU WILL DO —————

█ Embrace technophobia in a branching & looping dark war narrative where your behavior is recorded, analyzed, and weaponized against you

█ Move through twisted, kaleidoscopic environments that collapse and reassemble around you as you confront the real-world history the game doesn't want you to know

█ Handle a realistic modern arsenal: firearms, drones, & near-future-tech modelled with authentic detail, because authenticity is part of the conditioning

█ Uncover the full architecture of the system trapping you, if you still want to escape once you understand it

data.short_description: A psychological horror game where a demented commanding officer controls your every move, and the line between war simulation and real war dissolves into impossible, stunning spaces. You are not a soldier. You are being made into one.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X, Intel Core i7-9700K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 (8 GB), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (8 GB)
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
